hooks.name: validate-evidence-on-save
hooks.description: An evidence file was saved. Check every contract file under data/ against the Schema and the cross-file rules. A failure means the file must not be committed.

hooks.name: validate-evidence-on-create
hooks.description: An evidence file was created. Same check as on save.

hooks.name: validate-control-on-save
hooks.description: A control point or map area file was saved. Alignment and map areas feed every position error, so validate the whole data/ tree.

hooks.name: validate-control-on-create
hooks.description: A control point or map area file was created. Same check as on save.

hooks.name: validate-alignment-on-save
hooks.description: An alignment record was saved. Its error figures must recompute from its control points, so validate the whole data/ tree.

hooks.name: validate-alignment-on-create
hooks.description: An alignment record was created. Same check as on save.

hooks.name: validate-registry-on-save
hooks.description: The source registry was saved. Every feature cites registry sources, so validate the whole data/ tree.

hooks.name: schema-regenerate-and-conform
hooks.description: The evidence Schema was saved. Regenerate the TypeScript types, run the evidence tests (the TypeScript conformance test and the generated-types check among them), run the Python conformance test, then validate every committed data file against the changed Schema.

action.command: npm --prefix web run gen:types && npm --prefix web test -- src/evidence && uv --directory pipeline run pytest tests/validate/test_conformance.py && uv --directory pipeline run buried validate
